recognize_zh: IgD 染色中大部分淋巴球呈膜性／細胞質陽性，強度不一，陰性細胞散在並在中央條帶較多；脾邊緣區淋巴瘤常表現 IgD，這一點有別於大多數結節性邊緣區淋巴瘤及 MALT 淋巴瘤。
features: Dense sheet of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with membranous and cytoplasmic IgD positivity of variable intensity
Heterogeneous staining, with IgD-negative cells more concentrated in a paler central band
No discrete IgD-negative germinal centers visible in this field
describe_en: IgD immunohistochemical stain on spleen shows a dense lymphoid infiltrate in which most cells show membranous and cytoplasmic IgD positivity of variable intensity. A paler band with more IgD-negative cells traverses the center of the field. No discrete negative germinal centers are identified here. IgD expression by the neoplastic cells is frequent in splenic marginal zone lymphoma and helps distinguish it from nodal and extranodal marginal zone lymphomas; normal mantle zone B cells also express IgD, so correlation with the H&E architecture is required.

ddx.vs: Reactive IgD staining forms a discrete ring around germinal centers, whereas here positivity extends across the expanded nodules.
Mantle cell lymphoma is also IgD positive, but it is CD5 and cyclin D1 positive.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma (MALT) or nodal MZL
ddx.vs: These are usually IgD negative, with the entity separated by clinical distribution and splenic predominance.
